availability_checks.open_meteo_archive: HTTP 200 on 2026-11-15 for both tested ERA5 and ERA5-Land sample dates; response fields inspected. ERA5-Land precipitation and wind fields were null in Mexico sample, so daily rain/temp/wind use ERA5; soil variables use ERA5-Land. ERA5-Land 10m hourly wind also null. soil_temperature_0cm unit undefined; excluded. 0-7cm and 7-28cm soil temperature, 0-7cm soil moisture returned units and non-null data.

temperature_hv_targeted_falsification.target: ERA5 2 m mean temperature versus HV scene median and baseline-deviation common mode

seasonal_trend_adjusted_temperature_vs_h.model: intercept + linear time trend + annual sin/cos day-of-year
seasonal_trend_adjusted_temperature_vs_h.warning: exploratory one-cycle adjustment; low effective degrees of freedom and serial dependence; not causal

temperature_hv_targeted_falsification.first_difference_note: Adjacent observation differences only; irregular intervals are not treated as equal physical rates.
temperature_hv_targeted_falsification.seasonal_note: One annual sin/cos cycle plus linear trend; exploratory with low effective degrees of freedom.

mexico.method: Two-sided date-level exploratory correlations; no best-lag selection. Legacy *_cell_median_residual preserves point-own-temporal-median class summary and does NOT remove scene/date common mode. New point_own_baseline_class_median aliases it. True local residual: d_it=x_it-median_t(x_i), g_t=median_i(d_it), r_it=d_it-g_t; class summaries are median_i(r_it) by WorldCover class. Dates, not pixels, are temporal units; no pixel bootstrap.
